name: sehatly-openapi-types
description: Isolated toolchain that turns docs/openapi.yaml into web/src/types/api.d.ts. It is a separate package because openapi-typescript requires typescript ^5 as a PEER dependency and calls its JavaScript compiler API (`ts.factory`), while web/ deliberately compiles against typescript ^7 (the plan's todo-3 pin, with the reason written down there). npm cannot satisfy both in one tree, so the generator gets its own.
